unit: USD per million tokens (MTok), Anthropic API list price
what_this_is: API list prices used to put a dollar figure on recorded tokens. Estimates of API-equivalent cost, not bills. Under a Claude subscription nothing here is charged per token.

rules.cache_read: per-model rate below (0.1x base input; 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5; 0.025x on Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1)
rules.cache_write: 5-minute and 1-hour writes have separate rates; usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens and ephemeral_1h_input_tokens say which a call used; a write total with no split is priced at the 5-minute rate and counted as unclassified
rules.fast_mode: usage.speed == 'fast' on Opus 5.5 / Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 multiplies every rate by fast_multiplier (page: input and output are doubled; caching multipliers apply on top)
rules.haiku_5_5_long_prompt: a request whose prompt (input + cache read + cache write tokens) exceeds 100,000 tokens is priced at the long-prompt rates, per request
rules.unknown_model: tokens are reported, dollars are left out and the model is listed as unpriced

aliases_for_telemetry_without_a_model_id.note: Bentham's AGENT_USAGE.csv rows carry model ids; Herschel's TRACE.jsonl carries only the alias. The alias is read as the current model of that family, which is an assumption.

bentham_price_table_in_measure_py.note: Copied from jobs/bentham/measure.py PRICE_TABLE on origin/main for the comparison. These are the Opus 5 and Sonnet 4.x rates; the models in the transcripts are Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, which list lower, with cache reads at 0.05x base input.
